aspects.label: Hilbert–Pólya truncations and the measured tightness wall
aspects.summary_de: Die Trunkierungsnotiz trennt algebraabhängige Trunkierungszustände von einer gemeinsamen Testalgebra; eine gemessene Tightness-Barriere ist kein Beweis für die vollständige RH-Aussage.
aspects.summary_en: The truncation note distinguishes algebra-dependent truncation states from a common test algebra; a measured tightness wall is not a proof of the full RH statement.
aspects.mapping_rationale: K3 is explicitly described as measured tightness, and the wall is stated in four equivalent languages; no theorem of RH follows from that framing.
